api_base_url.description: API Base URL. Keep the default value. No change required.

api_cache_ttl.description: API Cache TTL. Keep the default value. No change required.

name.description: The name of the API key.

secret.description: The secret part of the API key.

comment.description: A comment to describe this cache setting.

domain_id.description: Stores domain ID of the subdomain.

enabled.description: Define wether this cache setting is enabled or not.

enforce.description: Enforce cache TTL allows you to set the cache TTL (Cache Control: max-age) in the backend regardless of the response sent from your Origin.

not_found_ttl.description: How long an object will be cached. Origin responses with the HTTP codes 404 will be cached.

path.description: Path which must match to cache response.

sort.description: The order in which the cache rules take action as long as the cache sorting is activated.

subdomain_name.description: The Subdomain for the cache setting.

active.description: Define wether this subdomain should be protected by Myra or not.

alternative_cname.description: The alternative CNAME that points to the record.

caa_tag.description: Tag value for `CAA` records. Available values are `issue`, `issuewild`, `issuemail`, `issuevmc`, `iodef`, `contactemail` and `contactphone`.

comment.description: A comment to describe this DNS record.

domain_name.description: The Domain for the DNS record.

enabled.description: Define wether this DNS record is enabled or not.

encryption.description: Encryption for `DS` records. Available values are `3` (DSA/SHA1), `5` (RSA/SHA1), `6` (DSA-NSEC3-SHA1), `7` (RSASHA1-NSEC3-SHA1), `8` (RSA/SHA-256), `10` (RSA/SHA-512), `12` (GOST R 35.10-2001), `13` (ECDSA-P256/SHA256), `14` (ECDSA-P384/SHA384), `15` (ED25519) and `16` (ED448).

hash_type.description: Hash type for `DS` records. Available values are `1` (SHA-1), `2` (SHA-256), `3` (GOST R 34.11-94) and `4` (SHA-384).

name.description: Subdomain name of a DNS record.

record_type.description: A record type to identify the type of a record. Valid types are: A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA , PTR and DS.

value.description: Depends on the record type. Typically an IPv4/6 address or a domain entry.

backup.description: Marks the server as a backup server. It will be used when the primary servers are unavailable. Cannot be used in combination with "Preserve client IP on the same upstream".

fail_timeout.description: Double usage: 1. Time period in which the max_fails must occur until the upstream is deactivated. 2. Time period the upstream is deactivated until it is reactivated. The time during which the specified number of unsuccessful attempts "Max fails" to communicate with the server should happen to consider the server unavailable. Also the period of time the server will be considered unavailable. Default is 10 seconds.

max_fails.description: The number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server that should happen in the duration set by "Fail timeout" to consider the server unavailable. Also the server is considered unavailable for the duration set by "Fail timeout". By default, the number of unsuccessful attempts is set to 1. Setting the value to zero disables the accounting of attempts. What is considered an unsuccessful attempt is defined by the "Next upstream error handling".

weight.description: Weight defines the count of requests a upstream handles before the next upstream is selected.

auto_update.description: Auto update flag for the domain.

paused.description: Shows if Myra is paused for this domain.

paused_until.description: Date until Myra will be automatically reactivated.

content.description: HTML content of the error page.

domain_id.description: Stores domain ID of the subdomain.

error_code.description: Error code of the error page.

subdomain_name.description: The Subdomain for the error page.

comment.description: A comment to describe this IP filter.

expire_date.description: Expire date schedules the deaktivation of the filter. If none is set, the filter will be active until manual deactivation.

subdomain_name.description: The Subdomain for the ip filter.

value.description: The IP you want to whitelist or blacklist. By using CIDR notation on IPv4 IPs, you are able to define whole subnets.

active.description: Status if the maintenance page is active or not.

domain_id.description: Stores domain ID of the subdomain.

subdomain_name.description: The subdomain name for this maintenance.

content.description: HTML content of the maintenance template.

domain_name.description: The Domain for the maintenance template.

comment.description: A comment to describe this redirect.

destination.description: Target where redirect should point to.

enabled.description: Define wether this redirect is enabled or not.

sort.description: The ascending order for the redirect rules.

antibot_post_flood.description: Detection of POST floods by using a JavaScript based puzzle.

antibot_post_flood_threshold.description: This parameter determines the frequency how often the puzzle has to be solved. The higher the value the less likely the puzzle needs to be solved.

antibot_proof_of_work.description: Detection of valid clients by using a JavaScript based puzzle.

antibot_proof_of_work_threshold.description: This parameter determines the frequency how often the puzzle has to be solved. The higher the value the less likely the puzzle needs to be solved.

balancing_method.description: Specifies with which method requests are balanced between upstream servers.

block_not_whitelisted.description: Block all IPs, which are not whitelisted.

block_tor_network.description: Block traffic from the TOR network.

cdn.description: Use subdomain as Content Delivery Node (CDN).

client_max_body_size.description: Sets the maximum allowed size of the client request body, specified in the “Content-Length” request header field. Maximum 5120 MB.

cookie_name.description: Specifies the cookie name when balancing_method is cookie_based

diffie_hellman_exchange.description: The Diffie-Hellman key exchange parameter length.

enforce_cache_ttl.description: Enforce using given cache TTL settings instead of origin cache information. This will set the Cache-Control header max-age to the given TTL.

http_origin_port.description: Allows to set a port for communication with origin via HTTP.

ignore_nocache.description: If activated, no-cache headers (Cache-Control: [private|no-store|no-cache]) will be ignored.

ip_lock.description: Prevent accidental IP address changes if activated. This setting is only available on 'domain level' (general domain settings).

ipv6_active.description: Allow connections via IPv6 to your systems.

limit_allowed_http_method.description: Not selected HTTP methods will be blocked.

limit_tls_version.description: Only selected TLS versions will be used.

monitoring_alert_threshold.description: Errors per minute that must occur until a report is sent.

monitoring_contact_email.description: Email addresses, to which monitoring emails should be send. Multiple addresses are separated with a space.

monitoring_send_alert.description: Enables / disables the upstream error reporting.

myra_ssl_certificate.description: Authentication to the origin. An SSL Certificate (and chain) to be used to make requests on the origin.

myra_ssl_certificate_key.description: The private key for the SSL Certificate

next_upstream.description: Specifies the error that mark the current upstream as "down".

only_https.description: Shall the origin server always be requested via HTTPS?

proxy_cache_bypass.description: Name of the cookie which forces Myra to deliver the response not from cache.

proxy_cache_stale.description: Determines in which cases a stale cached response can be used when an error occurs.

proxy_connect_timeout.description: Timeout for establishing a connection to the upstream server.

proxy_read_timeout.description: Timeout for reading the upstream response.

request_limit_block.description: Show CAPTCHA after exceeding the configured request limit.

request_limit_level.description: Sets how many requests are allowed from an IP per minute.

request_limit_report.description: If activated, an email will be send containing blocked ip addresses that exceeded the configured request limit.

request_limit_report_email.description: Email addresses, to which request limit emails should be send. Multiple addresses are separated with a space.

source_protocol.description: Protocol to query the origin server.

ssl_client_certificate.description: Specifies a file with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to verify client certificates.

ssl_client_header_fingerprint.description: Contains the fingerprint of the certificate, the client used to authenticate itself.

ssl_client_header_verification.description: The name of the header, which contains the ssl verification status.

ssl_origin_port.description: Allows to set a port for communication with origin via SSL.

waf_enable.description: Enables / disables the Web Application Firewall.

waf_policy.description: Default policy for the Web Application Firewall in case of rule error.

configuration_name.description: Set specific ssl configuration for ciphers and protocols

extended_validation.description: True if the certificate has extended validation

subdomains.description: List of subdomains where to assign the certificate

subject_alternatives.description: Sub domain(s) the certificate is valid for

valid_from.description: Date and time the certificate is valid from

valid_to.description: Date and time the certificate is valid to

wildcard.description: True if the certificate contains a wildcard domain

sort.description: Order in which `WAF` tags are processed

subdomain_name.description: The subdomain of the tag assignment

title.description: The Title of the tag assignment

type.description: The Type of the tag assignment
